# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for uses of `Object#freeze` on immutable objects.
      #
      # NOTE: Regexp and Range literals are frozen objects since Ruby 3.0.
      #
      # NOTE: From Ruby 3.0, this cop allows explicit freezing of interpolated
      # string literals when `# frozen-string-literal: true` is used.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   CONST = 1.freeze
      #
      #   # good
      #   CONST = 1
      class RedundantFreeze < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include FrozenStringLiteral

        MSG = 'Do not freeze immutable objects, as freezing them has no effect.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[freeze].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          return unless node.receiver
          return unless freeze_check_enabled_at?(node)
          return unless redundant_freeze_immutable_receiver?(node.receiver)

          add_offense(node) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(node.loc.dot)
            corrector.remove(node.loc.selector)
          end
        end

        private

        # @!method operation_produces_immutable_object?(node)
        def_node_matcher :operation_produces_immutable_object?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (begin (send {float int} {:+ :- :* :** :/ :% :<<} _))
            (begin (send !{(str _) array} {:+ :- :* :** :/ :%} {float int}))
            (begin (send _ {:== :=== :!= :<= :>= :< :>} _))
            (send _ {:count :length :size} ...)
            (block (send _ {:count :length :size} ...) ...)
          }
        PATTERN
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    # Common functionality for dealing with frozen string literals,
    # magic comments, immutability of literals, and related string
    # construction and correction helpers used by several cops.
    # rubocop:disable Metrics/ModuleLength
    module FrozenStringLiteral
      module_function

      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL = '# frozen_string_literal:'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_ENABLED = '# frozen_string_literal: true'
      FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27 = %i[str dstr].freeze
      NUMERIC_ARITHMETIC_OPERATORS = %i[+ - * ** / % <<].freeze
      NUMERIC_RIGHT_ARITHMETIC_OPERATORS = %i[+ - * ** / %].freeze
      COMPARISON_OPERATORS = %i[== === != <= >= < >].freeze
      COUNT_LENGTH_SIZE = %i[count length size].freeze
      SHAREABLE_CONSTANT_VALUES = %w[
        literal experimental_everything experimental_copy
      ].freeze
      SHEBANG_PREFIX = '#!'
      MAGIC_COMMENT_KINDS = %i[
        frozen_string_literal encoding shareable_constant_value typed
      ].freeze

      private_constant :FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27

      def frozen_string_literal_comment_exists?
        leading_comment_lines.any? { |line| MagicComment.parse(line).valid_literal_value? }
      end

      private

      def frozen_string_literal?(node)
        frozen_string = if target_ruby_version >= 3.0
                          uninterpolated_string?(node) || uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
                        else
                          FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL_TYPES_RUBY27.include?(node.type)
                        end

        frozen_string && frozen_string_literals_enabled?
      end

      def uninterpolated_string?(node)
        node.str_type? || (node.dstr_type? && node.each_descendant(:begin).none?)
      end

      def uninterpolated_heredoc?(node)
        return false unless node.dstr_type? && node.heredoc?

        node.children.all?(&:str_type?)
      end
      alias frozen_heredoc? uninterpolated_heredoc?

      def frozen_string_literals_enabled?
        ruby_version = processed_source.ruby_version
        return false unless ruby_version

        # Check if a magic string literal comment specifies what to do
        magic_comments = leading_comment_lines.filter_map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
        if (literal_magic_comment = magic_comments.find(&:frozen_string_literal_specified?))
          return literal_magic_comment.frozen_string_literal?
        end

        # TODO: Ruby officially abandon making frozen string literals default
        # for Ruby 3.0.
        # https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/11473#note-53
        # Whether frozen string literals will be the default after Ruby 4.0
        # or not is still unclear as of July 2024.
        # It may be necessary to add this code in the future.
        #
        #   return ruby_version >= 4.0 if string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?
        #
        # And the above `ruby_version >= 4.0` is undecided whether it will be
        # Ruby 4.0 or others.
        # See https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/20205 for details.
        # For now, offer a configuration value to override behavior is using RUBYOPT.
        return false if string_literals_frozen_by_default?.nil?

        string_literals_frozen_by_default?
      end

      def frozen_string_literals_disabled?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal == false
        end
      end

      def frozen_string_literal_specified?
        leading_comment_lines.any? do |line|
          MagicComment.parse(line).frozen_string_literal_specified?
        end
      end

      def leading_magic_comments
        leading_comment_lines.map { |line| MagicComment.parse(line) }
      end

      def leading_comment_lines
        first_non_comment_token = processed_source.tokens.find { |token| !token.comment? }

        if first_non_comment_token
          # `line` is 1-indexed so we need to subtract 1 to get the array index
          processed_source.lines[0...first_non_comment_token.line - 1]
        else
          processed_source.lines
        end
      end


      def ensure_magic_comment_records
        source_key = processed_source.object_id
        if @magic_comment_records.nil? || @magic_comment_source_id != source_key
          @magic_comment_source_id = source_key
          @magic_comment_records = leading_comment_lines.map { |line| parse_line_as_magic_comment(line) }
        end
        @magic_comment_records
      end

      def parse_line_as_magic_comment(line)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        comment = MagicComment.parse(line)
        @magic_comment_records << comment unless @magic_comment_records.include?(comment)
        comment
      end

      def magic_comment_with_frozen_string_setting
        records = ensure_magic_comment_records
        found = records.find do |comment|
          comment && comment.frozen_string_literal_specified?
        end
        @magic_comment_records = records
        found
      end

      def magic_comment_with_encoding_setting
        records = ensure_magic_comment_records
        found = records.find do |comment|
          comment && comment.encoding_specified?
        end
        @magic_comment_records = records
        found
      end

      def magic_comment_with_shareable_constant_setting
        records = ensure_magic_comment_records
        found = records.find do |comment|
          comment && comment.shareable_constant_value_specified?
        end
        @magic_comment_records = records
        found
      end

      def magic_comment_with_typed_sigil
        records = ensure_magic_comment_records
        found = records.find do |comment|
          comment && comment.typed_specified?
        end
        @magic_comment_records = records
        found
      end

      def emacs_magic_comment_line?(line)

        return false if line.nil? || line.empty?

        matched = if line.include?('-*-')
                    MagicComment.parse(line).is_a?(MagicComment::EmacsComment)
                  else
                    false
                  end
        @magic_comment_records << line if matched
        matched
      end

      def vim_magic_comment_line?(line)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        return false if line.nil? || line.empty?

        matched = if /#\s*vim:/i.match?(line)
                    MagicComment.parse(line).is_a?(MagicComment::VimComment)
                  else
                    false
                  end
        @magic_comment_records << line if matched
        matched
      end

      def simple_magic_comment_line?(line)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        return false if line.nil? || line.empty?

        parsed = MagicComment.parse(line)
        matched = if emacs_magic_comment_line?(line) || vim_magic_comment_line?(line)
                    false
                  else
                    parsed.any?
                  end

        matched
      end

      def shebang_source_line?(line)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        return false unless line

        result = line.start_with?(SHEBANG_PREFIX)
        @magic_comment_records << :shebang if result
        result
      end

      def encoding_magic_comment_line?(line)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        return false unless line
        return false if shebang_source_line?(line)

        parsed = MagicComment.parse(line)
        result = if parsed.encoding_specified?
                   true
                 elsif Style::Encoding::ENCODING_PATTERN.match?(line)
                   true
                 else
                   false
                 end
        @magic_comment_records << parsed if result
        result
      end

      def frozen_string_literal_comment_token(source = processed_source)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        token = source.tokens.find do |item|
          item.text.start_with?(FROZEN_STRING_LITERAL)
        end
        @magic_comment_records << token if token
        token
      end

      def last_special_comment_token(source = processed_source)
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        return nil if source.tokens.empty?

        token_number = 0
        token = nil
        if source.tokens[token_number].text.start_with?(SHEBANG_PREFIX)
          token = source.tokens[token_number]
          token_number += 1
        end

        next_token = source.tokens[token_number]
        if next_token&.text&.valid_encoding? &&
           Style::Encoding::ENCODING_PATTERN.match?(next_token.text)
          token = next_token
        end

        @magic_comment_records << token if token
        token
      end

      def ordered_magic_comment_line_indexes
        records = ensure_magic_comment_records
        encoding_line = nil
        frozen_line = nil
        records.each_with_index do |comment, index|
          if comment.encoding_specified?
            encoding_line = index
          elsif comment.frozen_string_literal_specified?
            frozen_line = index
          end
          break if encoding_line && frozen_line
        end
        @magic_comment_records = records
        [encoding_line, frozen_line]
      end

      def encoding_comment_out_of_order?
        encoding_line, frozen_line = ordered_magic_comment_line_indexes
        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        return false unless encoding_line && frozen_line

        encoding_line > frozen_line
      end

      def duplicate_magic_comment_line_map
        records = ensure_magic_comment_records
        comment_lines = {
          encoding_magic_comments: [],
          frozen_string_literal_magic_comments: []
        }
        records.each_with_index do |magic_comment, index|
          if magic_comment.encoding_specified?
            comment_lines[:encoding_magic_comments] << index
          elsif magic_comment.frozen_string_literal_specified?
            comment_lines[:frozen_string_literal_magic_comments] << index
          end
        end
        @magic_comment_records = records
        comment_lines
      end

      def duplicate_magic_comment_ranges

        @magic_comment_records = magic_comment_record_store
        extras = []
        comment_lines.each_value do |lines|
          next if lines.count <= 1

          lines[1..].each { |line| extras << line }
        end
        extras
      end

      def shareable_constant_comment_in_scope(node)

part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `uninterpolated_string?` in lib/rubocop/cop/mixin/frozen_string_literal.rb:45 — Ruby's shorthand interpolation (`"#@ivar"`, `"#$gvar"`, `"#@@cvar"`) produces a `dstr` with `ivar`/`gvar`/`cvar` children but no `begin` node, so the cop mistakenly treated such strings as uninterpolated (frozen) literals.

The fix adds `:ivar, :gvar, :cvar` to the descendant check, so these strings are correctly recognized as interpolated and `Style/RedundantFreeze` no longer flags `.freeze` on them (nor do `Style/MutableConstant`/`FrozenStringLiteralComment` treat them as frozen).
